title: Legacy report destination
responsibility: Routes an older report link to its stored revision or the explorer home.

inputs.name: reportDestination.index
inputs.description: The history index the destination is read from: its branches, its revisions and the legacy reports it links to commits. Null, or an index that holds no revisions, makes the result an empty string.

revisions.subject: Route legacy report links to the explorer
revisions.author: Pat Lin

inputs.name: reportDestination.report
inputs.description: The report being opened: its id selects the imported legacy linkage, and its recorded revision is tried first, matched exactly against the commits the index holds. Null names no report, so the result is the explorer home or an empty string.

outputs.name: reportDestination
outputs.description: Console-relative explorer path to Pages at the first of the report's recorded revision and imported legacy linkage that the index holds, scoped to a branch that lists that commit (preferring main or master) and to the commit alone when none does. Without such a commit it is Pages at the explorer home, and it is empty when the index is null or holds no revisions.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Thrown by encodeURIComponent inside explorerRoutePath when the branch name the address is built on holds an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate; nothing in the function catches it.
